node.title: Re: Help me understand this idiomatic hash from array code
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
As [tybalt89] already said, [doc://perldata#Slices] (and perhaps the [doc://perlop#Range-Operators] if you haven't come across that yet).

my @header_line = ('id', 'name', 'age'); @fields{@header_line} = (0 .. $#header_line); # is exactly equivalent to ($fields{id},$fields{name},$fields{age}) = (0,1,2);
